Game Overview

In Jewel Halloween, the core idea is straightforward: dive into a whimsical Halloween world where candy is king. Strategize your way through this 2D matching puzzle, swapping sweets for epic combos. With limited moves, carefully plan each match to unlock special candies and conquer over 300 spook-tacular levels. Treat yourself to endless sugary fun!
